description: Fingerprints of every project definition and inductive type, with proofs erased, read by tools/verify_project_axioms.py. A changed or removed entry fails the audit. New definitions are added with --add-definitions, which never rewrites an existing entry; changing an entry requires the owner's authorization and a FREEZE_LOG.md record.
fingerprint: String.hash of the printed type and value (constructor types for an inductive), after replacing every proof by True.intro
